annotations.title: Get a Google Drive picker link

description: Get a link the user opens to hand Hermoso files from their Google Drive (Google only shares files a person picks; Hermoso never sees the whole Drive). Returns url and a session id; folderId opens the picker inside a folder. Give the user the link, then call get_drive_picker_session until it says completed. Valid for an hour. Free.

folderId.description: open the picker inside this Drive folder

name: create_drive_picker_session
title: Get a Google Drive picker link
